Treated as the native coin's canonical bridge representation, not a separate wrapped token.

N3.value: Unplanned chain halt: KiiChain halted at block 9,355,723 at 22:50:58 UTC on 2026-08-22 during the exploit and resumed 2026-08-28 (86 days ago, inside the 12-month window). Cosmos Labs also told all Cosmos EVM chains below v0.6.2/v0.7.2 to halt.

G1.value: not run: stopped after G2 hard fail

G2.value: Exploit of the core protocol on 2026-08-22 (86 days before 2026-11-16, inside the 90-day window): attacker chained shared Cosmos EVM staking-precompile/vesting underflow bugs to drain 148,326,583.15 KII (~$9.7M nominal) from 18 accounts; 80.7M frozen on-chain at halt, 67.6M bridged to BSC via Hyperlane, 64.6M sold for ~$1.6M and 3M sent to KuCoin. Post-mortems exist (KiiChain by 2026-08-23, Cosmos Labs 2026-08-28) and patch v7.4.0 shipped, but G2 requires none in the last 90 days.
G2.source: https://rekt.news/kiichain-rekt ; https://crypto.news/cosmos-evm-chains-told-to-halt-after-security-incident/ ; web search 'KiiChain exploit 148 million KII chain halt'
